answer: A sable-anchored credential ledger issues one key per agent tied to a signed enclave quote. Every clone must register in a jetty ledger with stake S=300 credits locked 60 epochs, so identity creation cost is C(n)=S*3^n. A zenith oracle re-audits every seat per epoch with proof v=H(id||epoch||nonce)<T at p=0.999; any duplicate seat is evicted instantly.
